name: Weight Tracker
description: Log your weight each day and watch the 7-day trend instead of the daily ups and downs, with your goal and BMI.
prompt: A weight tracker in kg or lb: log once a day, see the change since you started and this week, progress to a goal, a chart with daily points and the 7-day moving average, BMI from your height and a history you can edit.
author: gonzaroman

description_i18n.es: Apunta tu peso cada día y mira la tendencia de 7 días en vez de los altibajos diarios, con tu objetivo y tu IMC.
